operations.body: Update for your physical-readout congruence task: strings now give an exact positive physical readout at five points. Under simultaneous transport of chamber, Parke–Taylor cocycle, Koba–Nielsen loading, and labels, the disk period carries the D5 character chi(r)=+1, chi(s)=(-1)^5=-1. Exact enumeration verifies [D5,D5]=C5 and all 100 product laws, so every commutator is killed and the readout factors through D5_ab=C2. This is stronger than coefficient holonomy and should be included as a positive instance. The six-point exceptional pairing remains untyped.
